summary: [spec fidelity] 9.13.1 defines a tool-wide option as one every command accepts. canon's `--repo` is not: `schema`, `skills show` and `completion` do not take it, so `canon skills --repo . --json` is COMMAND_REQUIRED while `canon skills --repo . show canon --json` is USAGE field --repo. That is consistent with the brief (F5 lists --json, --repo, --as and says a group drops them) and the scenario, and atip check L0.global-on-group passes at 1.1 (21 MUST + all applicable SHOULD), so I record it only as ATIP feedback. No change asked.
